title: Sparkly candle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Candle body -->
  <rect x="38" y="45" width="24" height="42" rx="4" fill="#FFD37A"/>
  <rect x="38" y="45" width="8" height="42" rx="4" fill="#FFE9A8"/>
  <!-- Wax drip -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="45" rx="12" ry="4" fill="#FFF1C4"/>
  <path d="M40 45 Q38 53 41 55 Q43 56 43 50 L43 45 Z" fill="#FFF1C4"/>
  <path d="M60 45 Q62 52 59 53 Q57 54 57 49 L57 45 Z" fill="#FFF1C4"/>
  <!-- Wick -->
  <rect x="49" y="38" width="2" height="8" rx="1" fill="#8B5E2A"/>
  <!-- Flame outer -->
  <path d="M50 15 Q58 26 56 34 Q54 40 50 40 Q46 40 44 34 Q42 26 50 15 Z" fill="#FF8C1A"/>
  <!-- Flame inner -->
  <path d="M50 22 Q54 29 53 34 Q52 37 50 37 Q48 37 47 34 Q46 29 50 22 Z" fill="#FFE24D"/>
  <!-- Flame core glow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="34" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#FFF9C4"/>
  <!-- Candle base -->
  <rect x="35" y="86" width="30" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#C98A3C"/>
  <rect x="35" y="86" width="10" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#E0A85A"/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <!-- Top left sparkle -->
  <g fill="#FFF27A">
    <path d="M22 20 L24 26 L30 28 L24 30 L22 36 L20 30 L14 28 L20 26 Z"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Top right sparkle -->
  <g fill="#7FFFD4">
    <path d="M78 18 L79.5 23 L84 24.5 L79.5 26 L78 31 L76.5 26 L72 24.5 L76.5 23 Z"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Left sparkle -->
  <g fill="#FFB3FF">
    <path d="M18 55 L19.5 59 L24 60.5 L19.5 62 L18 66 L16.5 62 L12 60.5 L16.5 59 Z"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Right sparkle -->
  <g fill="#B3E5FF">
    <path d="M80 52 L81.5 56 L86 57.5 L81.5 59 L80 63 L78.5 59 L74 57.5 L78.5 56 Z"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Small stars -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="38" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="35" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="25" cy="70" r="1.5" fill="#FFF27A"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="72" r="1.5" fill="#7FFFD4"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="15" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="12" r="1.2" fill="#FFB3FF"/>
</svg>
